[[File:Balloone1.jpg|thumb]]
The '''podrace balloons''' were balloons that visitors to the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]] could use to view the [[Podracing/Legends|Podraces]], from above the stands. This was a good alternative for people who couldn't afford good seats, but the balloons were often dangerous and easy targets.
